description: Create an empty native R2018 DWG without a template or source file. Hosted HTTP storage immediately saves an account-owned drawing with one-year (365-day) default retention and returns stable documentId, fileId and storedFile metadata. Entity, symbol and property edits are saved automatically and survive reconnects. Add geometry with cad.add_entities and preview with cad.show_document. Local stdio drawings stay in memory until cad.save_as.

units.description: INSUNITS: 0 unitless, 1 inches, 2 feet, 4 millimeters (default), 5 centimeters, 6 meters.

name: cad.create_document
